cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; an indoor book cafe with a gentle sloping carpeted reading ramp — sliding playfully down the low reading ramp on a wide seat cushion; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — standing; a small botanical conservatory hosting a playful public reading event — performing the finale of a story as an imaginary deep-sea cartographer; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — sitting on the ground; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — lying on her left side; a convention photo zone under ring lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — chest-deep in the water
